description:
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This is an exceptional opportunity for a seasoned nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. You will play a pivotal role in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and fostering a positive and productive work culture.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for managing and mentoring nursing staff, implementing best practices, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $105,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality healthcare.

If you are a passionate leader with a proven track record in skilled nursing and are ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding role, we encourage you to apply today. Join a team dedicated to providing outstanding care and support to our residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably within a skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal long-term care regulations.
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $105,000, based on experience and qualifications.
